visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of the Taipei cityscape under an overcast sky, with the Taipei 101 tower visible in the background. It quickly cuts to an indoor lobby where promotional signs for a lecture are displayed. People in casual clothing walk through the space, separated by a black stanchion and red velvet rope. (2) A close-up reveals stacks of books featuring a portrait of a woman on the cover. The camera then focuses on a woman with long dark hair, wearing a light-colored oversized blazer over a darker top and large hoop earrings. She is sitting at a desk, focused on signing copies of the book with a black marker. (3) The scene shifts to a large auditorium or event hall filled with a crowd of mostly young women. The woman from before is now on stage, holding a microphone and addressing the audience. A large projection screen behind her displays photos and text related to her presentation. She gestures with her hands while speaking, showing a calm and professional demeanor. (4) A montage sequence follows, showing the woman interacting warmly with attendees. She is seen hugging fans, receiving a bouquet of flowers, and having brief, intimate conversations. Many audience members are holding their phones up to record the event. The video concludes with several group shots of the audience waving and posing for photos with the author. The woman bows deeply to the audience as they applaud, before returning to a final cityscape shot of Taipei.
